job.job_description:
Job Summary:


We are seeking a skilled and motivated Amazon Q Developer Engineer / Architect to join a growing technology team focused on cloud-native application development, AI-powered engineering, and modern DevOps practices. The role involves designing, developing, and optimizing intelligent software solutions using Amazon Q Developer and AWS cloud services. Candidates will work on application modernization, automation, AI-assisted development workflows, and scalable cloud architectures while collaborating with cross-functional teams in a hybrid work environment.

This opportunity is suitable for both early-career professionals and experienced architects who are passionate about cloud technologies, generative AI, automation, and modern software engineering practices.

Key Responsibilities:


- Design, develop, and implement cloud-native solutions using Amazon Q Developer and AWS services
- Build scalable and secure applications using AWS Lambda, Amazon EC2, Amazon ECS/EKS, Amazon S3, API Gateway, and IAM
- Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using AWS CodePipeline, AWS CodeBuild, AWS CodeDeploy, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI/CD
- Create infrastructure automation solutions using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation
- Develop applications and backend services using Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Node.js, and Go
- Integrate AI-powered development workflows including prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and AI agents
- Support application modernization and legacy system transformation initiatives
- Implement containerization and orchestration solutions using Docker and Kubernetes
- Perform code optimization, performance tuning, and security reviews
- Generate technical documentation and support AI-powered testing strategies
- Collaborate with development, DevOps, QA, architecture, and business teams to deliver high-quality solutions
- Participate in solution architecture discussions and contribute to technical decision-making
- Monitor deployment quality, troubleshoot issues, and ensure operational stability
- Follow best practices for security, scalability, reliability, and maintainability

Required Skills:


- Hands-on experience with Amazon Q Developer and AWS cloud services
- Strong knowledge of AWS Lambda, EC2, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway, IAM, and DevOps services
- Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Java, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, C#, Node.js, or Go
- Experience with CI/CD automation tools including Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, and AWS DevOps tools
- Understanding of Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and Cloud Formation
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in cloud environments
- Knowledge of LLM fundamentals, prompt engineering, RAG architectures, and AI agents
- Understanding of software development lifecycle and modern engineering practices
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills


Preferred Skills:


- Experience with Bitbucket and JIRA
- Knowledge of AI-powered testing and automated documentation generation
- Exposure to code modernization and application transformation projects
- Familiarity with DevOps methodologies and cloud security practices
- Understanding of performance tuning and system optimization
- Ability to work in cross-functional and multicultural teams
- Japanese language proficiency is an added advantage
- Strong English communication and stakeholder management skills
- Awareness of risk management and governance practices

Qualifications:


- Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
- Relevant AWS certifications or cloud certifications are a plus
- Experience in cloud architecture, AI-enabled development, or enterprise application development is preferred

What We Offer:


- Opportunity to work on advanced AI and cloud transformation projects
- Exposure to modern AWS technologies and AI-assisted engineering practices
- Collaborative and innovation-driven work environment
- Career growth opportunities across engineering and architecture domains
- Hybrid work flexibility and continuous learning support

Candidates who are passionate about cloud computing, AI-driven software engineering, and scalable solution architecture are encouraged to apply.
